definition.scope: Modify aggressive10 only: original deep negative-funding timer guard, AFTER existing support-reopen exception. Veto this otherwise permitted affordable add only under frozen weak-hour condition. All genuine price-drop adds, shallow adds, nonnegative-funding adds, qualified SR support reopens and initial opens unchanged. No new exits/targets/sizing/shorts/live changes.

features.vwap_roc: Last completed1h close below turnover/volume VWAP of that hour's UTC session through its close AND last completed1h close-to-close ROC<0.
features.hour_structure: Last completed1h high<previous1h high AND close<previous1h low.
features.unknown: Restore original eligible deep guard if required price context unknown; never veto out-of-scope adds. Do not retune after results.

definition.timing: Evaluate at EVERY otherwise eligible/affordable add, never reuse first-event diagnostic labels. On block leave add clock/inventory/TP unchanged; reconsider at subsequent minute. Fill new approved orders next-minute open. Existing transactional partial clocks, ordinary exits and SR action priority unchanged. Shared frozen PriceContext primitives; no future hourly close, daily VWAP, pivot selection or hindsight gate.
definition.runOrder: 12 exact L15 control replays first (B17, guarded10h, aggressive10h x2 periods x2 TP models);8 primary variants;6 recent +60s repeats (aggressive parent and2 variants x2 TP models). 20 primary,26 executions total.
definition.periods: Older2025-07-01T00:00Z..2026-08-19T21:32Z; recent2026-05-17T20:43Z..2026-09-10T05:08Z. Flat32000 starts; overlapping and repeatedly examined, not a holdout.
definition.sourceDelay: Extra60s applies to NEW hourly/VWAP input cutoff AND existing rolling-high reference only, with current decision price/funding/pulse/outer gates retained. Parent source60 repeats provide matched-delay high-exit controls. Not a market-fill, network or maker queue simulator.
definition.provenance: Original economic sources and accepted stream byte-prefixes must hash-match; extra synced tails must all have source/closed-candle times AFTER frozen cutoff. Pin full current streams too. Reproduce 12 original complete digest/metric/monthly controls before evaluating variants. No repair/config/state mutation.
definition.incrementalScreen: Relative to unchanged aggressive10h: positive recent net delta both TP models, nonnegative older net both models, no DD increase, no monthly delta<-250, >=20 recent distinct NEW block episodes per model. Original B17 screen separately retained. Existing parent TP/high interventions do not inflate new block sample.
definition.report: All five setups with net/DD/WL winning and losing dollars, exact periods/fees, every monthly MTM delta vs B17 and aggressive parent; blocked checks vs episodes, unknowns, delay sensitivity, drawdown paths, forced/TP counts, matched/removed/replacement/end inventory attribution, largest positive/negative episode deltas. No selected loss totals presented as savings.
definition.verification: Independent raw hourly OHLC/VWAP, actual inventory per attempt, original funding/SR support permission, block/no-block and fill correspondence, every target/high opportunity, next-open fees/equity/DD/months, all control digests, all comparison partitions. Closed-prefix and bypass/reevaluation tests.
definition.boundary: Only these2 variants. No combined condition, threshold search, cooldown experiment, HL new condition, recovery exit or production deployment in this checkpoint.
